CardDescription.zh:
它的木材坚硬沉重，难以加工，但品质上乘；树皮可用于鞣制皮革或制作棕色染料。

秋季应能结出橡子。
CardDescription.en:
Its wood is hard to work with and heavy, but of high quality, and its bark can be used to tan leather or used to make brown dye.

Should produce acorns during autumn.
